# groups

A table. Named associations (ADR-021); entity_type is the members' type (ADR-054); character derived from events.

## Columns

| Column | Type | Constraints |
|---|---|---|
| `id` | TEXT | PRIMARY KEY |
| `name` | TEXT | NOT NULL UNIQUE |
| `note` | TEXT |  |
| `created_at` | TEXT | NOT NULL |
| `entity_type` | TEXT |  |

## Definition

From `spec/ledger.sql`, which is the machine-checkable form of SPEC.md §3:

```sql
CREATE TABLE groups (
  id          TEXT PRIMARY KEY,          -- ULID
  name        TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,
  note        TEXT,
  created_at  TEXT NOT NULL,
  entity_type TEXT                       -- ADR-054: the members' type; null = created before it (entity-blind)
);
```
